name: sparsity-calibration
abstract_description: Calibrate sparsity/complexity budgets against known solutions before searching. A solver failing can mean the encoding excludes all solutions, not that the problem is hard.
origin_result: n=3 searches used K<=3 for weeks; Laderman-23 needs K=7 in six triples, so those searches occupied a solution-free space (found 2026-09-09)
applicability: Any parameterized SAT/CP/optimization search with a sparsity or complexity budget
